Touchscreen functionality malfunctioned. I have not had this phone for long. The touchscreen functionality died one week ago. I am now unable to use the phone as I am unable to put in any information to unlock it from when it was turned off. At this stage it must get the password input and not only the fingerprint to unlock the phone for use. I am extremely disappointed. This phone is otherwise good. Takes excellent photos etc. There was no warranty on the phone, so at this point I am unsure how to proceed to get the phone repaired if it is reparable.

my phone has been simply amazing. It has recently been upgraded to OS 7 .... I was rather tentative about purchasing this phone. A lot of reviews I read stated a line appeared in the screen or some other defect. Hence, i delayed writing a review. So far, my phone has been simply amazing. It has recently been upgraded to OS 7 (nougant -i think). The battery life is amazing and requires little charging(guess this depends on your usage). I bought a screen protector and an ELV hard case (best case ever made) this means that the edge function that some people complain of frequently accidentally touching hasn't proved problematic for me as the case offers an all around protection. The video and picture quality are amazing! I totally love this product.

I would still recommend this phone over any other phone. In this review, I will be comparing the Galaxy S7 Edge to the Galaxy S6 Edge. When the Galaxy S6 came out last year, it was one of the most unique phones on the market. The dual curved display was something to behold, even though it was mainly good for the “waterfall” scrolling effect and coolness factor. It had and still has excellent hardware inside and the 5.1” screen fits in almost every type of hand. A year later we have the Galaxy S7 Edge, which comes with a bigger screen, bigger battery and better hardware.

This is why I recommend, that if you are planning on buying this phone from amazon, make sure amazon is the one fulfilling the order. I have had no problems at all when I order from a third party that allows amazon to fulfill the order. Also, it doesn't hurt to review the customer reviews on the actual seller as well. As far as the phone itself goes, it works perfectly. All the specs pretty much define what to expect from the phone. It's got the best screen in the world and the best camera. The glass finish makes it beautiful, but it's fingerprint prone and and extremely slippery. Other than that, I have no complaints.

Nice phone, but screen is burned.. This is a review for specifically the silver phone I purchased. The phone came exactly as desribed. Very light wear and tear, not scratches on the screen. The phone LOOKED great. The downside, when I powered up the phone, the AMOLED screen had burned in images on it. They are only super noticeable on a white screen but still annoying. This was my second phone from this seller, as I had to return the first because it had a dead spot on the screen. In short, they make sure the phone looks good, but clearly do not power the phone on to make sure the screen in good to go.

Screen and sound problems. Good phone, but has problems: 1. Fragile screen. Dropped from a chair height and cracked. Very expensive replacement. 2. Sound interruptions after a second. Especially bad for alarms. Not often but still annoying. 3. Curved screen is easy to touch by accident.
